extracted.intended_audience: regulated entities, stakeholders, and commenters interested in Employee Benefits Security Administration rules (insurers, plan fiduciaries, employee benefits attorneys, and members of the public submitting comments)
extracted.subtask_description: A Federal Register direct final rule (DFR) notice announcing withdrawal of a previously published DFR (removal of the definition of “plan assets” for insurance company general accounts) because the Department received significant adverse comments; includes metadata, contact information, and procedural statements about official publication and document drafting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use official PDF on govinfo.gov for legal edition
rubrics_metrics.description: This site displays a prototype of a “Web 2.0” version of the daily Federal Register. It is not an official legal edition of the Federal Register, and does not replace the official print version or the official electronic version on GPO’s govinfo.gov. Use the PDF linked in the document sidebar for the official electronic format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When relying on the Federal Register for legal research or citation, verify the material against the official print or govinfo.gov PDF. The XML rendition on FederalRegister.gov does not provide legal notice and should not be treated as the authoritative legal text.

rubrics_metrics.name: DFR withdrawal upon receipt of significant adverse comments
rubrics_metrics.description: In the DFR, the Department stated that if significant adverse comments (as defined in the DFR) were received by July 31, 2025, the Department would publish a timely notification in the Federal Register either withdrawing the DFR or issuing a new final rule which responds to significant adverse comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When issuing a direct final rule, agencies should specify the comment deadline and define what constitutes a 'significant adverse comment'; if such comments are received within the stated period, the agency must either withdraw the DFR or issue a new final rule responding to those comments. The notice here documents that significant adverse comments were received and the DFR is withdrawn effective August 11, 2025.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document heading elements to include in Federal Register documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Document headings vary by document type but may contain the following: the agency or agencies that issued and signed a document; the number of the CFR title and the number of each part the document amends, proposes to amend, or is directly related to; the agency docket number / agency internal file number; the RIN which identifies each regulatory action listed in the Unified Agenda of Federal Regulatory and Deregulatory Actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the Document Drafting Handbook for detailed instructions on required and optional heading elements when preparing Federal Register documents so that metadata (agency, CFR citations, docket number, RIN) is clearly presented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulations.gov retrieval is supplementary and not part of official FR
rubrics_metrics.description: FederalRegister.gov retrieves relevant information about this document from Regulations.gov to provide users with additional context. This information is not part of the official Federal Register document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat Regulations.gov content as supplemental contextual information; do not assume that material pulled from Regulations.gov is part of the official Federal Register document. Check the official FR PDF and the Regulations.gov docket separately when compiling the administrative record or reviewing submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify public inspection listings against final official edition for legal research
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are using public inspection listings for legal research, you should verify the contents of the documents against a final, official edition of the Federal Register. Only official editions of the Federal Register provide legal notice of publication to the public and judicial notice to the courts under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not rely solely on public inspection copies or FederalRegister.gov for legal notice; always compare to the final official FR edition on govinfo.gov for authoritative text and legal-effect determinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include accessible contact information in notices
rubrics_metrics.description: The notice supplies a point of contact: Susan Wilker, Office of Exemption Determinations, Employee Benefits Security Administration, (202) 693-8540. This is not a toll-free number. Individuals with hearing or speech impairments may access the telephone number above by TTY by calling the toll-free Federal Information Relay Service at (800) 877-8339.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Federal Register notices should provide clear contact information, note whether telephone numbers are toll-free, and include TTY/relay options to ensure accessibility for individuals with hearing or speech impairments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Docket identification and statement about supporting documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition of Plan Assets—Insurance Company General Accounts; Docket ID EBSA-2025-0038. Supporting Documents: No supporting documents available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices should list the docket identifier and explicitly state whether supporting documents are available. Users should consult the docket ID on Regulations.gov for additional materials or to confirm the presence/absence of supporting documents.
